description: Create a frozen dataset version snapshot by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI. If the dataset is unchanged since the previous snapshot the existing version is returned instead of a new one, and a passed description then replaces the existing version's note; omit description to leave that note untouched.

dataset.description: Dataset ref by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI.

description.description: Optional note describing this snapshot. If the existing version is reused, it replaces that version's note.

name: dataset_version_create
